message: Scaled 1 of 3 feed rates to 90 %; 1 left as a thread pitch, 1 left because the code means a threading cycle somewhere else. No machine: profile defaults assumed.

findings.message: F2.0 is not scaled: G78 is a threading cycle on another kind of machine or in another G-code system, where this F is the thread lead and not a feed rate. Check the block and scale it by hand if it really is a feed.
F2.0 is a thread pitch (G33), not a feed rate, so it is not scaled: scaling it would cut a different thread.
